chapter_summary.text: This recap lesson is for reviewing, sharing, and discussing problems or queries about item types covered so far, and for developing useful solutions and strategies. It also includes self and peer assessment of speaking, writing, reading, and listening skills, plus optional extra practice based on problem areas.

Reviewing and improving writing skills
Repeat the process as above, asking test takers to complete the assessment form on page 85 in the Official 
Guide and to look at the ‘Developing your writing skills’ sections on pages 86 and 87.

Reviewing and improving reading skills
Repeat the process as above, asking test takers to complete the assessment form on pages 116 and 117 in the 
Official Guide and to look at the ‘Developing your reading skills’ sections on pages 117 and 118.

Reviewing and improving listening skills
Repeat the process as above, asking test takers to complete the assessment form on page 164 in the Official 
Guide.

Using the information you have gathered about problematic areas from the stages above (or previous lessons), 
review the relevant activities or practice items, using test takers’ problem areas as your focus.

core_lessons.title: Start by Recapping Item Types and Skills

explanation.text: The lesson begins by recapping the item types covered so far, then asking small groups to list the skills needed for each item type without referring to the Official Guide.

evidence_spans.quote: Quickly recap the item types covered in the lessons so far and write the names on the board.

Put test takers into small groups and ask them to spend 5–10 minutes working together to briefly list the 
skills they need to master to complete each item type.

Encourage them not to refer to the Official Guide at 
this point and to express their thoughts in their own words.

question.text: List three item types from lessons 1-7 that the recap table connects with homework or feedback. Then write one skill area you would want to review for one of them.

answer.text: Possible answer: Answer short question; Read aloud; Repeat sentence. I would review listening and speaking skills for Answer short question.

question.text: Write a short peer-assessment prompt you could use with a partner after completing a practice item.

answer.text: Possible answer: Which part of my response was strongest, which part was weakest, and what one change should I try next time?

question.text: You have limited review time. How should you choose what to practise again in this recap lesson?

answer.text: Choose activities or practice items that learners want to repeat or review, and focus especially on problem areas identified during the recap or previous lessons.

question.text: Create a two-column review note with one column for a problem and one column for a possible solution.

answer.text: Possible answer: Problem: I lose focus during listening tasks. Solution: identify when the difficulty happens, ask classmates for strategies, and repeat a relevant listening practice item.

review_checklist.text: I can name the item types covered in the earlier lessons and connect them to the skills I need to practise.
I can describe which skills I feel confident about and which skills are most problematic for me.
I can discuss a practice problem with a partner or group and turn it into at least one improvement strategy.
I can use self and peer assessment to compare responses and identify a next step for speaking, writing, reading, or listening practice.
I can choose extra practice based on the problem areas that became clear during review.
